title: ClustersSidecar
description: `.halo/compare/<pair_id>/clusters.json` -- everything the review screen needs about one sheet pair, written next to the compare DXF it describes (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §7). The two files are produced together and must stay in step: `handle_to_cluster` maps handles *inside the compare DXF* to cluster ids, which is how a click in the viewer becomes a selected cluster. Also the body of `GET /compare/pairs/{pair_id}/clusters`, with the user's decisions merged in from the database. Written with `ensure_ascii=False, indent=2`, LF endings, and rounded coordinates, so the same inputs and the same `run_date` produce byte-identical bytes.

pair_id.description: `sheet_pair` row id -- also the name of the directory this file sits in.

pair_key.description: Normalised drawing number, or the file name when the sheet has none. Stable across re-runs, which is what lets decisions be carried over even after the row ids change.

layer.description: Layer the cloud marks and badges were drawn on, `REV-<YYYYMMDD>`. The compare DXF never carries the `-<n>` suffix; only the export adds it (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §2).

changes.description: Every change of the pair, ascending by `seq`, minor ones included.

handle_to_cluster.description: Compare-DXF handle -> cluster id, keys sorted. Covers the cloud, the badge shape and text, and every entity the cluster's changes wrote to `__CMP_ADDED`/`__CMP_REMOVED`. The viewer hit-tests a click, looks the handle up here, and selects that cluster. Every value must be the `id` of one of `clusters` -- JSON Schema cannot state that, so it is asserted by `packages/schema/test/compare.test.ts` and by `clustersSidecarIntegrityFailures`.
handle_to_cluster.$comment: The key and the value repeat the `handle` and `cluster_id` patterns instead of `$ref`-ing them: datamodel-code-generator turns a `$ref` in `propertyNames` into a RootModel, which is unhashable and cannot be a dict key in the generated pydantic model.

frame_geometry.title: SidecarFrame
frame_geometry.description: The after sheet's frame, which is the coordinate system of both the compare DXF and every box in this file.

bbox.description: The after frame's outline in millimetres.

scale_denominator.description: Read from the after title block (`1:50` -> 50). Null when it could not be read.

scale_factor.description: `scale_denominator / 100`, or 1.0 when the scale is unknown. Every `compare.yaml` `cloud` and `revtable` length is multiplied by it (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §5).

offset_before.description: `[dx, dy]` added to before-sheet coordinates to bring them into the after sheet's frame: `after.bbox.min - before.bbox.min`. `[0, 0]` when the two frames sit at the same origin.

counts.title: SidecarCounts
counts.description: Tallies the UI shows without walking the arrays. `clusters` and `changes` are the array lengths; `approved` + `ignored` never exceeds `clusters`.

minor.description: Changes folded as minor -- included in `changes`, excluded from every cluster.
